home_title: Inkisle — an island-conquest strategy game, made in public
home_desc: Inkisle is an offline, single-player island-conquest strategy game for phones, now in development. Send fleets between islands and tint the sea your color. Follow the making, one post a day.
hero_h1: Tint the sea, take the isles.
hero_lead: Inkisle is a quick island-conquest strategy game for your phone. Drag fleets from your islands to the next one: the bigger number takes the island and the ink spreads in your color. Each stage takes a few minutes.
hero_note: Not released yet. There is no store page, release date or final price. We are building it in the open and publishing the process here.
card1_p: Drag from your island to another one. Choose 25, 50, 75 or 100% of the troops to send.
card2_p: A fleet that arrives with more troops than the island holds captures it, and the island turns your color.
card3_p: Clear a stage, open the next one. Every sea adds one new rule, and none of it needs a network.
follow_p: We publish one journal post a day while Inkisle is built: why we chose this game, the rules, the art, the prototype and the mistakes along the way.
fact2: Stages of about 3 to 5 minutes, played upright with one hand.
fact3: Works offline: no account and no network needed.
fact4: Minimal vector art; each side has its own color and flag shape so it also reads without color.
fact5: Planned for iOS first, with Android developed alongside. No release date yet.
